race.description: Toowoomba Turf Club Sat Nights Hcp (C4)
race.comment: ROCK HARD LOVE (2) started favourite but gave away too much start when fresh from a spell over 1200m at this track last time. Has a better second-up record and is the winner of two from two here at 1400m. Looms as the clear threat. TRIBBIANI (5) made a move before the turn and was only narrowly denied at his latest appearance over 1200m at this track. Looks ideally placed over an extra 200m at this stage. WRIGLEY FIELD (6) drove hard late but found one better when resuming in a Class 2 over this course and distance recently. Building a nice record at this trip and looks genuine hope. ENFORCEABLE (7) is unbeaten here and has been in the money at ten of 11 overall. Impossible to leave out of calculations.
